Tiny deterministic checkpoints generated by `scripts/generate-hf-fixtures.py` with
PyTorch 2.14.0 and Transformers 5.20.2. They contain randomly initialized weights,
not downloaded model weights. `expected.json` stores Transformers eager FP32 logits
using the exact F32/F16/BF16 storage values. Configurations exercise GQA, separate
head dimension, nonconstant Q/K normalization weights, nondefault RoPE theta and
RMSNorm epsilon, tied/untied classifiers, and single/sharded safetensors.

Regenerate with `target/bench-venv/bin/python scripts/generate-hf-fixtures.py`.
`cargo test --locked` verifies the CPU path. GPU comparison additionally runs with
`LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/local/cuda/lib64 cargo test --locked --test hub -- --ignored`.
